summary: Test the connection to the CrowdSec LAPI and AppSec
description:
Checks the LAPI, and AppSec when its address is set, with the values in the body (not saved) over the saved ones; an empty secret uses the saved one. Fields set by environment variables always use the environment value. force is ignored. A failed check still answers 200 with ok false.

Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)

requestBody.description: Optional unsaved values to test with

200.description: The result: ok, and one check per service

name.description: The service checked: lapi or appsec

result.description: ok, or why the check failed: no_key, key_refused, refused, unreachable, tls_error or status

message.description: Details such as an HTTP status or a network error; empty when there is nothing to add

checks.description: One check per service, never carrying a key
